title: Countywide fraud risk assessment and hotline
summary: On June 30, a committee reviewed a Spire Hawaiʻi LLP fraud risk assessment of the County of Maui, which found county controls are not designed well enough to address the risks it identified. It also found no countywide policy for handling fraud complaints and no nepotism policy. The auditor said a new fraud, waste, and abuse hotline is now live.

timeline.text: The chair asked staff to send the report to boards and commissions that oversee departments that did not respond.
